Keeps the features of a vector that satisfy a filter on their attributes or on their geometry.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Filter, Vector, CQL, ECQL, Select<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorFilter`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector to filter. |
| `pCql` | String |  |  | The ECQL filter, as area > 10000 AND name LIKE 'Rio%'. |
